piece.headline: ARORA TAKES THE EARLY LEAD, BENCH BOOSTS DELIVER NOTHING
piece.standfirst: Rajat Arora is top after week one, Aleston is 3 behind, and every Bench Boost earned nothing from the bench.
piece.big_picture: Rajat Arora leads Aleston by 3, and both burned a Bench Boost for nothing. The sharper fight is lower down: Mudit and Ram are level on the big prizes line. One week in, and already tight.
piece.decision_of_the_week: Udit and Kartik each left 25 points on the bench. Utkarsh left 24. Picking the wrong 11 hurt more than any chip choice this week.
piece.one_to_watch: Arora leads Aleston by 3. Both have spent their Bench Boost, so every captain call could matter. Mudit and Ram are level on the big prizes line, and neither can afford a blank.

winners.name: Rajat Arora
winners.verdict: Top of the pile, 36 above the average. The Bench Boost added nothing. The starting side did every bit of it.

winners.name: Aleston
winners.verdict: Second best score in the league, 33 above the average. The Bench Boost gave nothing back. Still only 3 off the top.

winners.name: Aditya
winners.verdict: 26 above the average. The Bench Boost gave nothing back, so the starters earned all of it. Chip gone, lead not yet.

losers.name: Tanish
losers.verdict: Lowest score in the league, 30 below the average. Week one only. Plenty of time to recover.

losers.name: S.M.
losers.verdict: 21 below the average, with 10 points sitting on the bench. A rough opener, and the bench knows it.

losers.name: Rajat Bhalla
losers.verdict: 22 points left on the bench is the story. That's the selection that stung most.

ratings.l: Best week in the league. The Bench Boost gave nothing, and he still won it.
